description: China - Overseas Finance Inventory Database is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Policies and plans", published or maintained by Zhou L., Z. Ma, S. Liu, X. Ma, K. Acker, M. Myers, D. Brautigam, and K. Gallagher. (World Resources Institute). The COFI database includes power-generation projects in Belt and Road Initiative (BRI) countries financed by Chinese corporations and banks that reached financial closure from 2000 to 2020. Types of financing include debt and equity investment, with the latter including greenfield foreign direct investments (FDI) and cross-border mergers and acquisitions (M&As). Coverage: China. It has 1 file in ZIP. The portal files it under Policies and plans. The portal gives 2022 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
